message: 終わりはなく、始まりが来る
Morning is here!

name: Synn
message: 「Is everyone here yet?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We walked to school together, so it's fine.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh? I don't see Lolotte anywhere.」

name: Ria
message: 「You're right, oh no.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyooone!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look, look! Everyone is suuuper hyped up!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah, the energy is amazing.」

name: Misa
message: 「If you get too carried away, you'll pay for it later.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Can't help it. Being sleep-deprived just makes me extra hyped! It's the festival, the festival!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, just don't push yourself too hard.」
Everyone, including the day-of executive committee members, goes over today's schedule together.

name: Misa
message: 「Please take breaks in shifts. Make sure to hand over your duties at headquarters before going on break.」

name: Synn
message: 「Does anyone else have any questions?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nope!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Sacchin. So you're on the executive committee.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I figured I'd come help you out, Nana-chan, ehehe.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you saying the sweetest things.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm looking forward to that reward cake\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Go home!」

name: Shio
message: 「I have hastened here on this occasion to bolster my elder sister's maiden battle.」

name: Misa
message: 「You really don't need to do that.」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall swiftly vanquish any ruffians myself, so pray inspect the grounds at your leisure.」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you. Make sure you contact headquarters properly before doing anything, though.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm so happy I get to see Ria looking all dressed up and shining again」

name: Ria
message: 「Calling it 'shining' is such an exaggeration, Akane-chan\s01」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You mustn't lose to your juniors, now. Do your very best out there」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Thanks」
There sure are a lot of familiar faces on the executive committee.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh. So you're on the executive committee too, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why don't you join the executive committee」

name: Azel
message: 「No」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you here, then?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's noisy」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought you liked quiet places」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up」

name: Synn
message: 「Right~ Everywhere's gonna get pretty noisy today, after all. I wonder if there's somewhere quiet around here」

name: Azel
message: 「You're the one who's noisy」

name: Synn
message: 「? Hey, Azel. Since you're here anyway, let's enjoy it together」

name: Azel
message: 「Enjoy it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah! You're missing out if you don't have fun. Why not go do some shopping or something? There might be quite a few hidden gems」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
He walked away.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn~. What are you doing? It's about to start」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. Coming~」
I step up in front of the Student Council, the executive committee members, and everyone from the shopping district running stalls.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright then, let's give it our all today too!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Let's do thiiis!!」
And so, the Ryuusei Academy Kira-Kira Festival officially began.
